sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(frame,r0,c0):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else ('o' if a[r][c]=='P' else '.') for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def black(g):
    return tuple(x.replace('o','.') for x in g)
cycles={}
# slot 0 cycle from earlier data (7 variants)
cycles[0]=[('#####','#o#o#','#o###','#ooo#','#####'),('#####','o#oo#','o#oo#','o####','oooo#'),
('oo#oo','#####','#o#o#','#####','oo#oo'),('####o','#oo##','#ooo#','##oo#','o####'),
('oo#oo','#####','#ooo#','#ooo#','#####'),('#####','#ooo#','#####','o#o#o','o###o'),
('oo###','oo#o#','#####','#o#oo','###oo')]
for target in range(1,5):
    c0=15+7*target
    start=glyph(current_frame,52,c0)
    seq=[start]
    for i in range(12):
        action(['UP'])
        g=glyph(current_frame,52,c0)
        seq.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    cycles[target]=seq[:-1]
    if target<4: action(['RIGHT'])
print('cycle lengths:', {k:len(v) for k,v in cycles.items()})
def cardglyph(r0,c0):
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
blue=[black(glyph(current_frame,41,15+7*i)) for i in range(5)]
cards={'S11':cardglyph(5,13),'S13':cardglyph(5,36),'S21':cardglyph(14,13),'S23':cardglyph(14,36),'S31':cardglyph(23,13),'S33':cardglyph(23,36),
'P12':cardglyph(5,23),'P14':cardglyph(5,46),'P22':cardglyph(14,23),'P24':cardglyph(14,46),'P32':cardglyph(23,23),'P34':cardglyph(23,46)}
for i in range(5):
    idx=[j for j,g in enumerate(cycles[i]) if black(g)==blue[i]]
    print('slot',i,'blue-in-cycle:',idx)
allc=[black(g) for cs in cycles.values() for g in cs]
for name,g in cards.items():
    if g in allc: print(name,'in cycles')
print('cursor now at slot 4')
result={'cycle_lengths':{k:len(v) for k,v in cycles.items()}}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
